drafted_from: workflow row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json, the shipped rule row local-businesses-by-place in tools/workflows/read-data/candidate-rules.json and tools/workflows/test/outreach-recipes.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:reach-local-businesses-by-zip-code for roofers in zip code 00000, sending from hello@example.com (my main domain is example.com) in America/Chicago, SES region us-east-1, under product-roof-quotes, using the businesses my maps connection gives."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Set up a separate sending address on a domain that is not your main one (like hello@example.com, verified in your Amazon SES region) and take the businesses for the zip code and kind from your map data connection as items, each with its reviews.

2. Say "Run workflow:reach-local-businesses-by-zip-code" with zip_code, category, items, from, main_domain, time_zone, product_id and region. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps identity, find, addresses, local-detail, versions, style, write, judge, pace, send, outcomes, record, call, call-outcomes, compare.
3. At identity the sending domain must be verified and differ from your main domain, else it stops and tells you.

4. At find, each business is scored by its reviews (slow-quote complaints weight 3, a spike of new reviews weight 2, 5 or more reviews in 90 days weight 1); only businesses with at least one signal stay, and only addresses matching your patterns (by default a gmail.com or info@ address) are written to.

5. Approve the emails (a local detail in the first line, two openings compared); they go out on Saturday from the separate address, then the same list is called; the compare step says which opening drew more replies.

worked_examples.title: A roofer with 3 slow-quote reviews and a spike of new reviews scores 5
worked_examples.ask: Find roofers in my zip code whose reviews show they need help.

reviews.text: Was slow to quote, waited for a quote two weeks

worked_examples.given: From tools/workflows/test/outreach-recipes.test.mjs: a business whose numbers are slow_quote_reviews 3, recent_reviews 2 and recent_review_share 0.5, scored with the shipped row local-businesses-by-place, matches slow-quotes (3 is at least 2, weight 3) and review-spike (0.5 is at least 0.4, weight 2) but not new-reviews (2 is under 5), so its score is 5 and it is kept.
